==About me==

''We'll drink the wine till the cup is dry,<br />And kiss the girls so they'll not cry,<br />And toss the dice until we fly,<br />To dance with Jak O' the Shadows.

We'll dance all night until the moon runs free,<br />And dandle the lasses upon our knee,<br />And then you'll ride along with me,<br />To dance with Jak O' the Shadows.

We'll sing all night, and drink all day,<br />And on the girls we'll send our pay,<br />And when it's gone, then we'll away,<br />To dance with Jak O' the Shadows.

There's some delight in ale and wine,<br />And some in girls with ankles fine,<br />But my delight, yes, always mine,<br />Is to dance with Jak O' the Shadows.

We'll toss the dice however they fall,<br />And snuggle the girls be they short or tall,<br />Then follow young Mat whenever he calls,<br />To dance with Jak O' the Shadows.''
